workflow_scale_routing.rationale: The emotional movement needs three adjacent beats, but they can fit in one compact storyboard without long-work support.
reroute_triggers: Artist expands this into a short film, feature film, or dependent scene sequence.
Recurring characters, timeline rules, or continuity dependencies become active.

story_structure.name: Threshold Crossing
story_structure.core_movement: A figure reaches a charged boundary where change is possible, but the crossing itself becomes delayed or transformed.
story_structure.adaptation_summary: The storyboard separates the approach, the threshold pressure, and the unresolved residue into three compact beats.
story_structure.turn_logic: The audience expects the lit doorway to explain itself, but every beat withholds the cause more sharply.
story_structure.compression_rule: Keep the event in one location and make each beat change distance, information, or pressure.
story_structure.expansion_rule: Expand into scenes or sequences only if the hallway threshold needs durable continuity or character history.
failure_modes: the missing figure appears too soon
the ending explains the source of the light

beats.one_move_summary: A warm doorway appears at the end of a dark hallway before its cause is known.
beats.before_state: The hallway feels ordinary and empty.
beats.after_state: The lit doorway turns the emptiness into an invitation.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: Warm light suggests welcome or safety.
expectation_turn.actual_result: No host appears, so the welcome becomes uncertain.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: A comforting signal becomes the first pressure point.

beats.emotional_payload: The invitation is real, but nobody claims it.

tension_profile.name: Presence / Absence
tension_profile.emotional_function: makes the absent person feel active

source_evidence: The reference centers on an open door and the pressure of not knowing who left it that way.
must_preserve: warmth that is not automatically safe

pivot_options.label: threshold
pivot_options.next_move: Move closer to the doorway without revealing the room.
pivot_options.rationale: The emotional pressure increases when the expected answer remains withheld.

medium_translation_notes.image: A distant warm doorway in a dark hallway.
medium_translation_notes.video: A slow establishing shot that makes the invitation unavoidable.
medium_translation_notes.sound: Low room tone with no human source.
medium_translation_notes.text: A sentence that notices the light before naming fear.
medium_translation_notes.mixed_media: Stillness in image, pressure in sound.

traceability_notes.note: The artist wanted invitation and unease to arrive together.

beats.one_move_summary: The viewer reaches the door, but proximity makes the absence more forceful instead of resolving it.
beats.before_state: The door is distant enough to feel like a clue.
beats.after_state: The door is close enough to feel like a demand.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: Getting closer should reveal what is inside.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The closer frame reveals only more withholding.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: Proximity intensifies absence instead of solving it.

beats.emotional_payload: The threshold feels like a choice the viewer cannot make.

tension_profile.name: Control / Surrender
tension_profile.emotional_function: makes the viewer feel pulled toward a withheld answer

source_evidence: The door remains half open, holding a threshold rather than a reveal.

pivot_options.label: residue
pivot_options.next_move: Leave the viewer with the mark the threshold makes.
pivot_options.rationale: The piece should end in consequence rather than explanation.

medium_translation_notes.image: A low close frame on the door edge and spilled light.
medium_translation_notes.video: A closer shot that holds after the expected reveal should arrive.
medium_translation_notes.sound: One small floor creak under the voiceover.
medium_translation_notes.text: A single question that does not receive an answer.
medium_translation_notes.mixed_media: Text asks the question while image refuses the answer.

traceability_notes.note: The artist wanted the threshold to stay emotionally unresolved.

beats.one_move_summary: The video stays with the light left on the floor after the invitation should have resolved.
beats.before_state: The threshold seems about to demand entry.
beats.after_state: Only the mark of the threshold remains.

expectation_turn.expected_direction: A final beat should reveal the room, the person, or the decision.
expectation_turn.actual_result: The frame removes the door and holds only the light's residue.
expectation_turn.surprise_function: The ending shifts from cause to consequence.
expectation_turn.emotional_counterpoint: The absence becomes quieter and more permanent.

beats.emotional_payload: What remains matters more than what caused it.

tension_profile.name: Cause / Consequence
tension_profile.emotional_function: withholds cause while preserving emotional consequence

tension_profile.name: Presence / Absence
tension_profile.emotional_function: lets absence remain active after the image empties out

source_evidence: The reference values the after-feeling more than literal explanation.
must_preserve: the final image feels like aftermath

medium_translation_notes.image: A cropped rectangle of light without the doorway.
medium_translation_notes.video: A locked final shot that fades before explaining anything.
medium_translation_notes.sound: Room tone thinning into near silence.
medium_translation_notes.text: No final caption; let the residue stand.
medium_translation_notes.mixed_media: Sound disappears while image holds the mark.

traceability_notes.note: The artist wanted the ending to stay unresolved instead of explanatory.

tension_points.summary: The absent person feels more present because the doorway is lit and open.
tension_points.intended_feeling: drawn toward someone who may not be there
source_evidence: The open door implies someone without showing them.

traceability_notes.note: Presence and absence both stay active through the storyboard.

tension_points.summary: The threshold leaves a visible consequence without revealing a cause.
tension_points.intended_feeling: left with the mark of a choice not made
tension_points.emotional_payload: The residue carries the unresolved decision.
source_evidence: The final feeling depends on what remains after the viewer does not enter.

traceability_notes.note: The plan preserves consequence while withholding cause.

key_emotional_movements.emotional_shift: welcome becomes danger without losing tenderness

traceability_notes.note: The first two beats carry the main emotional turn.
The ending keeps the absence active after the threshold is no longer shown.

tension_movement_plan.contrast_goal: Each beat should change the viewer's distance, information, or pressure around the lit threshold.

minimum_tension_criteria.waiver_rule: A repeated frame may be accepted only if repetition deliberately increases dread or residue.

adjacent_beat_shifts.shift_summary: Distance becomes proximity while withholding increases.
The expected cause disappears, leaving only consequence.

tension_movement_plan.reviewer_instruction: Block if adjacent storyboard beats only repeat the same doorway information without changing pressure, proximity, or residue.

arc_summary.turn: Approach makes the absence louder instead of revealing an answer.
arc_summary.scale_rationale: Three beats are enough for invitation, threshold pressure, and residue without creating a larger film continuity problem.

traceability_summary.note: The video Beat Plan adapts the threshold into invitation, threshold, and residue.
The sequence preserves active absence and unresolved ending.
